headline: OpenAI ships GPT-6 Astra into the AGI debate, Tesla opens Cybercab rides in Austin, and Berlin's ransomware deadline hits today.

stories.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra
facts: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra; Greg Brockman framed it as possibly the start of the "AGI era"
First OpenAI model designated at Critical cybersecurity capability under the Preparedness Framework
Pitch: stronger coding, multistep agents, computer use, polished docs/spreadsheets/presentations
Daybreak / trusted defenders first; Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise and API (incl. Azure) over coming days
Safety briefings stress post–Hugging Face safeguards, 24/7 misalignment monitoring, opaque recurrence concerns
HN: openai.com launch post ~1,615 points / ~1,390 comments overnight
stories.whyItMatters: The biggest model drop since GPT-5 lands with an AGI claim and a Critical cyber label — capability race and safety politics in one package.

image.alt: Collage of an illuminated robot’s finger.

stories.title: Tesla opens Cybercab rides in Austin
facts: Purpose-built two-seat Cybercab (no steering wheel or pedals) enters Tesla Robotaxi service in Austin
Invite-only rides at the Sep 3 launch; public fares via the Robotaxi app from Fri 5:00 p.m. CT
~45 Cybercabs on Texas roster vs hundreds of Model Y robotaxis — assignment not guaranteed
Tesla also claims 1M unsupervised autonomous miles on the Robotaxi fleet; Asia display tour (HK/Tokyo/Beijing/Shanghai) this month
stories.whyItMatters: First commercial trips in a production vehicle with no manual controls — the autonomy thesis leaves the demo stage.

stories.title: Berlin ransomware deadline is today
facts: Rhysida claims ~5.7–5.8 TB stolen from Berlin state admin (exfil Aug 7–12; attack public mid-Aug)
Darknet auction minimum 30 BTC (~€2M); Senat says it will not pay
Senatskanzlei warned citizen, employee and company personal data could be published from Fri 4 Sep
~12,000 state systems under forensic check; passwords confirmed among stolen material
stories.whyItMatters: The hybrid-threat storyboard from yesterday's BKA Lagebild now has a live German capital deadline.

stories.title: Google Assistant sunset starts on Android
facts: Google begins removing Assistant on phones/tablets from 4 Sep; rollout may take weeks
Gemini becomes the only assistant once a device is switched — no revert
Also covers Wear OS, Gemini-compatible headphones, and Android Auto projected from a phone
Cars with Google built-in, Google TV and Home speakers/displays are out of this wave
stories.whyItMatters: The classic voice assistant era on Android ends on a hard date — Gemini is no longer optional for most handsets.

stories.title: ISRO puts EOS-05 into transfer orbit
facts: GSLV-F17 lifted off Sriharikota ~02:55 IST Fri; ~2,367 kg EOS-05 (GISAT-1A) injected to sub-GTO
India's first dedicated imaging satellite designed for geosynchronous orbit; 19th GSLV / 107th Sriharikota launch
Onboard thrusters will raise it to ~36,000 km GEO for continuous regional imaging
First ISRO success of 2026 after January PSLV-C62 failure
stories.whyItMatters: A strategic GEO imager finally joins India's mostly LEO Earth-observation fleet.

stories.title: Xiaomi EVs aim at Germany in 2027
facts: At IFA Berlin, Xiaomi Auto signed MoUs with eight German dealer groups (Emil Frey, Hahn, LUEG, Dello, Dinnebier, Fett & Wirtz, Penske-Jacobs, SPT Avior)
Europe sales targeted for 2027; Munich R&D hub already open; China SU7 deliveries claimed >700k since spring 2024
WiWo: ~15 sales sites and ~30 service points planned for metro regions; agency model with fixed prices
stories.whyItMatters: Another Chinese EV brand plants a German dealer network while local PHEV strategy keeps stumbling.

stories.title: Xbox Cloud Gaming gets monthly hour caps
facts: From November: Ultimate 15h / Premium 10h / Essential 5h per month; extra hours for sale later
Microsoft says ~4% of subscribers hit by the change; unlimited cloud was a pitch for prior price hikes
Non-subscribers will also buy hours to stream owned games (details in November)

stories.title: What tools coding agents actually install
facts: Armature measured 17k Claude/Codex/Cursor runs on which tools agents choose to install
Companion HN thread: "Grep beats LSP?" — agents still lean on simple search over fancy language servers
